Below is the job description for the position:

Job Title: Maximo Developer / Admin

Work Type: Hybrid (4 Days Onsite, 1 Day Remote)

Locations:
• Arlington, VA 22202 (Monday, Thursday)
• Duration: 6+ Months (Possible Extension)

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Maximo Developer / Administrator to lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of the IBM Maximo Application Suite (MAS 9) environment. This role combines system administration and technical development, with a strong focus on complex integrations and Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) workflows.

The ideal candidate will manage the full lifecycle of Maximo applications, including Red Hat OpenShift container management, automation scripting, and enterprise integrations.

Scope of Work

The contractor will provide senior-level IBM Maximo development and administrative services to support configuration, customization, integration, and operational improvements within the Airports Authority’s Maximo environment.

Responsibilities include:
• Supporting IBM Maximo Application Suite (MAS 9) on a Red Hat OpenShift containerized platform
• Delivering system administration, application development, integration design, troubleshooting, and operational support
• Supporting enterprise asset management processes across airport operations, assets, and commercial platforms
• Managing complex integrations, including EDI workflows
• Ensuring system reliability across development, test, and production environments

Key Responsibilities

Task 1 – Maximo System Development & Configuration
• Conduct stakeholder workshops to gather business and technical requirements
• Translate requirements into functional specifications and technical designs
• Design, develop, configure, and implement solutions within IBM Maximo MAS 9
• Configure workflows, security groups, domains, escalations, and applications
• Administer and maintain Maximo on Red Hat OpenShift
• Collaborate with vendors on EDI Strategic Asset Management (eSAM) framework

Task 2 – System Administration
• Serve as Tier 3 technical lead for complex issues and performance optimization
• Manage environments across Development, Test, and Production
• Support upgrades, patches, and MAS 9 feature implementations
• Troubleshoot and resolve system issues in line with SLA requirements
• Develop automation scripts using Jython/Python
• Perform customizations using Maximo Business Objects (MBOs) and Application Designer
• Collaborate with DevOps and infrastructure teams for deployments
• Support IBM Maximo EAM (Transportation, Fleet, and Facilities)
• Provide additional administrative support as needed

Task 3 – System Integration & Interface Development
• Design and implement integrations with systems such as Workday, GIS, and IoT platforms
• Develop integrations using Maximo Integration Framework (MIF)
• Configure REST APIs, SOAP services, JMS messaging, and OSLC standards
• Manage inbound and outbound data integrations
• Ensure data integrity, synchronization, and system reliability
• Support mobile and offline data integration requirements

Task 4 – Troubleshooting & Production Support
• Investigate and resolve production issues
• Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions
• Maintain system performance and stability
• Provide escalation support for critical technical issues

Technical Documentation
• Develop and maintain:
• Integration documentation
• System configuration documentation
• Architecture updates
• Incident resolution documentation for major issues

Thanks & Regards

Infojini Consulting

Website: https://www.infojiniconsulting.com

Address: 10015 Old Columbia Road, Suite B 215, Columbia, MD 21046
